title: Catalog search offers Try again only when a retry can help
acceptance: A 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED in catalog search (TrackSearch search mode and the Music tab search in Dashboard.tsx) shows its sentence with no Try again; network, timeout and 5xx failures keep Try again.
The Music tab search shows the API sentence for quota and the Spotify allowlist instead of the generic "Couldn’t search … right now. Try again."
nextAction: Split from RF-74 (2026-11-13), which fixed the playlist surfaces only. On main the TrackSearch search-mode error row always renders Try again, and Dashboard.tsx Music search swallows the API error and shows the generic retry sentence. Propose the change, then implement with tests.

evidence.summary: Music tab search .catch() drops the error and always sets the generic retry sentence; the Try again button shows whenever results are null. Read on fix/rf-74-playlist-retry, 2026-11-13.
